scientific_integrity: An exact finite-dimensional theorem for ideal PXP blockade on all complete multipartite graphs with at least three nonempty parts and arbitrary strictly positive real site drives. The proof establishes the full zero eigenspace dimension and the vacuum zero-energy projector. Exact rational finite-size computations cross-check the formulas but do not replace the infinite-family proof. The novelty assessment is provisional and does not imply comprehensive historical priority.
scientific_limitations: Requires exact no-cross-part excitation blockade, zero detuning, no losses and coherent site-specific spin flips. Exact zero-energy resonance is discontinuous under generic drive detuning; the theorem makes no finite-time discontinuity, spectral-gap, decoherence, or higher-particle dynamical claim.
title: An arithmetic zero-mode switch in weighted multipartite blockade dynamics
